comment: Curated import-compatibility aliases for Hevy exercise titles that the
deterministic auto-matcher cannot resolve against the Free Exercise DB
naming (e.g. 'Bench Press (Barbell)' vs 'Barbell Bench Press - Medium Grip').
Every title must exist in the vendored Hevy template catalog and every
slug must exist in the pinned Free Exercise DB snapshot - the build
fails otherwise. Extend this list only with verified, unambiguous pairs.
